## CAPI-owned production render-event path

Render-origin observation ownership and event staging remain entirely inside CAPI or use an
already accepted non-public capability. Remove the Issue-120 public mutable controller producer and
do not replace it with another public or `doc(hidden)` mutable protocol entrypoint, exported helper,
feature setter, queue injector, event constructor, token factory or generally callable capability.
The protocol may expose only an unavoidable read-only view already authorized by Issue 120; its
wire, queues, replay and staging behavior do not change.

The shipped CAPI path remains bounded, preallocated and completely charged. Render publishes only
fixed observations with atomics or an equivalent accepted bounded realtime-safe handoff. It does
not allocate/free, lock, encode, mutate a controller, destroy, call I/O/syscalls/logging or perform
an unbounded operation. CAPI control/dequeue code owns draining, diagnostic meaning, event staging
and encoding. No retained collection grows after construction, and reliable diagnostic retry plus
lossy meter/counter coalescing/drop behavior stays byte-identical to the Issue-120 literal vectors.

Tests stimulate all six families only through existing exported C commands, source submission,
render and dequeue. No direct protocol queue/stage call, second session/controller, test-only event
producer or mutable setup backdoor may supply an observed event. Preserve invalid-lane, empty,
zero-capacity query, one-short canary/non-consumption, exact retry, reliable FIFO/no-drop and lossy
1/1 counter evidence.

## Primitive remaining resource authority

Keep the external production-layout oracle independent of every production resource getter,
projection, report and admission helper. Retain the verified explicit CAPI controller/exchange/
provider/replay/event/fixed-payload owner derivation, then replace each remaining opaque expected
fact for both current and prospective owners:

- derive compiled-model retained bytes and largest allocation from primitive container/type
  layouts, canonical/session fixture strings and independently enumerated source/track/route/effect/
  parameter counts;
- derive graph/plan audio buffers, node/edge/schedule/level/reduction metadata, bank buffers and
  largest allocations from primitive element layouts, explicit sample rate/quantum/bank widths and
  independently enumerated fixture graph/cohort shapes; and
- derive source PCM rings and source control/Arc/queue overhead from channel/ring capacities,
  primitive element/header layouts and independently enumerated fixture sources.

Literal totals may remain only as final frozen comparison values; they cannot be inputs to the
expected calculation. The expected path must not call `CompiledSession::resource_estimate`, any
session/CAPI/graph/source/effect/builtin resource report, protocol queue/replay projection,
plan-exchange projection, or a helper that returns the quantity under proof.

For every named primitive owner, omission and one-byte/count/shape miscount mutations must flow
through the actual expected-value calculation and fail its production comparison. A tautological
`assert_ne!(total + 1, total)`, recomputation that never reaches the comparison, or mutation of only
an already aggregated subtotal is insufficient. Preserve aggregate-versus-maximum-single
mutations, exact-cap success, atomic one-below rejection, public report rows and post-render active
resource transition.
